definitions.name: L1A.ARGMAX
definitions.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
definitions.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, first on ties

definitions.name: L1A.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES L1A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: key of a Record whose (numeric) value is largest, first key on ties

definitions.name: L1A.JOINSP
definitions.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: join a Vector of space-free Strings with single spaces ('' for empty)

definitions.name: L1A.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CW' BIND CW 0 GET UPPER CW 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word with first letter upper, rest lower

definitions.name: L1A.ABS
definitions.body: 'AB' BIND AB AB -1 MUL MAX
definitions.note: absolute value, lifts over Vectors

definitions.name: L1A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'QT' BIND QT LENGTH 'QN' BIND QT QN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET QT QN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector

definitions.name: L1A.MAD
definitions.body: 'QV' BIND QV QV L1A.MEDIAN SUB L1A.ABS L1A.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a numeric Vector

definitions.name: L1A.BRVAL
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'BX' BIND 1 -1 BX '(' EQ NOT BX '[' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String to Vector of +1 (opener) / -1 (closer)

definitions.name: L1A.BRSTEP
definitions.body: 'RC' BIND 'RA' BIND RA -1 GET RC 2 COLLECT JOIN 'RP' BIND RA -1 DROP RA RC 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RP '()' EQ NOT RP '[]' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT GET
definitions.note: bracket-stack step: stack char -> stack popped if char closes top, else pushed (stack seeded with '#')

definitions.name: L1A.REDUCE
definitions.body: CHARS [ '#' ] [ L1A.BRSTEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String to '#' plus the chars left after deleting matched pairs

definitions.name: L1A.BALPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS [ '#' ] [ L1A.BRSTEP ] SCAN 'BP' BIND BP [ LENGTH 0 MUL 1 ADD ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN [ 'BI' BIND BI 0 BP BI 1 SUB GET LENGTH 1 EQ SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: length of the longest balanced prefix of a bracket String

definitions.name: L1A.BYNAME
definitions.body: ZIP 'LZ' BIND LZ 0 GET LZ 1 GET GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [key amount] pairs to Record key -> summed amount, first-appearance order

definitions.name: L1A.DEBTORS
definitions.body: L1A.BYNAME 'DR' BIND DR KEYS [ 'DK' BIND DR DK GET 0 LT ] FILTER
definitions.note: names whose summed amounts are negative, first-appearance order

definitions.name: L1A.RLESTEP
definitions.body: 'XE' BIND 'XA' BIND XA -1 GET 'XL' BIND XA -1 DROP XL 0 GET XL 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT XA XE 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 XL 0 GET XE EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: run-length FOLD step: runs value -> runs with last count bumped or [value 1] appended

definitions.name: L1A.RLE
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV RV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ L1A.RLESTEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: run-length encoding [ [ value count ] ... ] of a non-empty Vector

definitions.name: L1A.UPSTEP
definitions.body: 'UX' BIND 'UA' BIND UA 1 GET 1 ADD 1 UX UA 0 GET GT SELECT 'UC' BIND UX UC UA 2 GET UC MAX 3 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [prev cur best] for longest strictly increasing run

definitions.name: L1A.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'UV' BIND UV UV 0 GET 0 0 3 COLLECT [ L1A.UPSTEP ] FOLD 2 GET
definitions.note: length of the longest strictly increasing adjacent stretch

definitions.name: L1A.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'MJ' BIND MJ TALLY 'MT' BIND MT L1A.TOPKEY 'MK' BIND MK NIL MT MK GET 2 MUL MJ LENGTH GT SELECT
definitions.note: value occurring in more than half the positions, else NIL

definitions.name: L1A.PRESENT
definitions.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: drop NIL elements of a Vector

definitions.name: L1A.FFILL
definitions.body: 'FV' BIND FV FV L1A.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'FX' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FX FX NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: forward-fill NILs; leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: L1A.GAPSTEP
definitions.body: 'GX' BIND 'GA' BIND GX GA 1 GET 1 ADD GA 1 GET GX GA 0 GET NOT AND SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [prevMissing count] counting starts of missing runs

definitions.name: L1A.GAPS
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP FALSE 0 2 COLLECT [ L1A.GAPSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: number of runs of consecutive NILs

definitions.name: L1A.LGSTEP
definitions.body: 'KX' BIND 'KA' BIND KA 0 GET 1 ADD 0 KX SELECT 'KC' BIND KC KA 1 GET KC MAX 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [cur best] for longest run of TRUE

definitions.name: L1A.LONGGAP
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP 0 0 2 COLLECT [ L1A.LGSTEP ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 if none)

definitions.name: L1A.SCALED
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND SV L1A.PRESENT G0D.MAXV 'SM' BIND SV [ SM DIV ] MAP
definitions.note: each present value divided by the largest present value, NILs kept
